name: Shinobi Shadow Stalker
purpose: Display on auto-clicker ninja upgrades and secret map paths.
visual: Agile shinobi crouched on curved pagoda roof under full blood moon.
prompt: A minimalist 2D graphic illustration for a premium video game, inspired by bold cinematic silhouette poster art. A nimble ninja shadow stalker crouched on the curved roof of a Japanese pagoda holding a kunai dagger, pure pitch-black silhouette against a colossal solid crimson-red full moon, high contrast negative space, clean vector edges, no anime, no 3D, no text.
